subtitulo: Stock corrections and opening inventory. Each adjustment is recorded in the stock card with its reason and the person responsible.

ayuda.entera: This product is not sold in fractions.

efecto.inmutable: A recorded adjustment cannot be edited or deleted; to correct it, record another one in the opposite direction.

validacion.cantidadFormato: Enter a quantity greater than zero, with at most 3 decimals.
validacion.cantidadEntera: Use a whole quantity: this product is not sold in fractions.
validacion.existencias: The outbound quantity exceeds the available stock ({{disponibles}}).
validacion.costoRequerido: Enter the unit cost of the inbound adjustment.
validacion.costoFormato: Up to 12 integer digits and 4 decimals, no negative values.
